title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-16
lineage: ? > C > CDR > EAC > CE Pro > CDWAV > FLAV (level 8)

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording with okay sound captures a magical 1973 set featuring China>Rider, Bird Song, Playin' in the Band and a Dark Star>Truckin'>Dew jam.
ai_review.review: The show is remembered as an intimate, high‑energy performance with an enviable setlist—opening with China>Rider and delivering standout moments like Bird Song, Playin' in the Band and a sprawling Dark Star sequence. The audience recording is only okay in fidelity, but its ambient crowd noise adds to the nostalgic feel of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high energy, standout songs) weighted heavily, while the recording is only fair; combined score yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is okay but not great; audience ambience is audible and contributes to an intimate atmosphere, though clarity is limited.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Opens strong with China>Rider and maintains momentum through classic jams, delivering a cohesive and engaging set.
